How it's built

Inside the timeline

V1STORY CUT

Pacing that earns every second

Every cut is a decision, not a default. I structure edits around the hook, the payoff, and the moments in between that keep a viewer from reaching for the next thumbnail.

A1SOUND DESIGN

Sound you feel before you notice

Whooshes, risers, and silence used on purpose. Sound design carries emotion and rhythm so the picture doesn't have to do all the work alone.

C1COLOR & PACE

A consistent look, frame to frame

Grading and rhythm tuned to the platform it's built for — reels, shorts, or long-form — so the finished cut feels intentional, not assembled.

M1MOTION & ANIMATION

Motion that makes the edit feel alive

Custom animation inside the edit — text reveals, kinetic typography, icons, transitions, camera moves, zooms, and subtle motion graphics that support the story without distracting from it.
